verses.text: Ayik ix k'och winhaj José yuj heb' winh ismaelita t'a Egipto chi', ay jun winh skuch Potifar ix mananel winh. Ha jun winh chi', niwan yopisio winh t'a winh sreyal Egipto, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey chi'.
Ha Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj José chi', te wach'nhej yajek' winh t'a spat winh spatrón chi'.
Ix nachajel yuj winh spatrón winh chi' to ay wal och Jehová yet' winh, wach'nhej tz'elk'och winh t'a smasanil.
Yuj chi', te wach'nhej winhaj José t'a yichanh winh spatrón chi'. Ix yak'och winh winh stanhwumalok spat yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay.

Yiktax ix yak'anoch winh winhaj Potifar chi' stanhwumalok spat chi', ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Potifar chi' yet' masanil tas ay t'a winh. Yujnhej winhaj José chi' ix k'echaanh swach'k'olal t'a spat winh yet' t'a najateli.

Ix kannhej winhaj José chi' stanhwumalok smasanil, yuj chi' manhxalaj tas ix sna' winhaj Potifar chi', palta anhej tas tz'aj sb'o swael winh syila'. Te wach' yilji winhaj José chi', te wach' pax sniwanil winh smasanil.
Ix ek' jab'ok tiempoal, haxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Potifar chi', ix te kan snib'ej ix t'a winhaj José chi'. Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Oktom wal syal a k'ool tzach way wet'ok, xchi ix.

Te maj schalaj sk'ol winhaj José tas ix yal ix chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Maay, ojtak ach tik to ix in yak'och winh etb'eyum stanhwumalok masanil stastak t'a tik. Ina manhxo jab'ok tas sna' winh yuj masanil stastak yakb'an ay in eq'ui.

Malaj junokxo mach niwan yelk'och t'a wichanh t'a jun pat tik. Masanil tastak ayoch t'a yol in k'ab', anhej t'ayach a ach tik, max yal-laj wak'anoch in k'ab', yujto yetb'eyum ach winh in patrón, ¿tom ol yal in k'ulan jun niwan chukal, yik tz'och in mul t'a sat Dios? xchi winh.
Ix ochnhej ijan ix stewioch t'a winh. Junjun k'u syal ix to sway winh yet' ix, palta junelnhej max ochlaj t'a sk'ol winh sway yet' ix, max yalpaxlaj sk'ol winh sk'och b'aj ayek' ix.
Ay jun k'u ix och winhaj José chi' t'a yol pat yik smunlaji, malaj junokxo mach ayeq'ui, anhej ix.

Haxo ta' ix och tzuktzuk ix t'a spichul winh, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Wayanh wet'ok, xchi ix. Haxo ix yab'an jun chi' winh, ix spich'anel sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Ix elta lemnaj winh t'a ti pat, haxo spichul winh ix kan t'a yol sk'ab' ix.
Ayik ix yilan ix to ix el lemnaj winh, ix kan spichul winh t'a yol sk'ab' ix,

ix el yaw ix, ix yawtankot heb' munlajwum ix t'a slak'anil pat chi', ix yalan ix: --Ilek wal jun winh hebreo ix yik'kot winh wetb'eyum tik. Ha winh tik, snib'ej winh tzin yixtej. Ix ochul lemnaj winh t'a yol pat tik, snib'ej winh sway wet'ok, palta chaanh ix el waw.
Ayik ix yab'an winh yel waw chi', ix el lemnaj winh, haxonhej spichul winh ix kani, xchi ix.
Ix sik'ankan jun spichul winh chi' ix masanto ix jax winh spatrón winh chi' t'a spat.
Ix yalan ix icha ix aj yalan t'a sb'ab'elal chi': --Ha winh hebreo ix ik'kot chekab'ok tik, ix ochul winh t'a yol in kuarto, snib'ej winh ix way wet'ok.
Palta te chaanh ix el waw, yuj chi' ix el lemnaj winh, haxonhej spichul winh ix yaktejkan t'a tik.
Icha wal chi' ix in yutej jun winh a chekab' tik, xchi ix. Haxo winh spatrón winhaj José chi', ix te kot yowal winh sik'lab'il ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Ix schekan yamjok winhaj José chi' winh, ix yalan winh to tz'och winh t'a preso b'aj ayoch juntzanh heb' winh t'a preso yuj winh rey.
Palta aynhejoch Jehová yet' winhaj José chi', ix sch'oxnhej swach'k'olal t'a winh. Yuj chi' te wach' ix elk'och winh t'a yol sat winh tanhwum preso chi'.
Haxo winh tanhwum preso chi' ix ak'anoch winh stanhwumalok heb' yetpresowumal chi'. Ix ak'jipaxoch winh yilumalok tastak ix sb'o heb' t'a preso chi'.
Ha winh stanhwumal preso chi', manhxalaj tas sna winh, masanil tas aykanoch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj José chi' yuj winh. Yujto aynhejoch Jehová yet' winh, yuj chi' wach'nhej ix elk'och smasanil.
